The short facts for disposal of the instant Rule is that the Petitioners as plaintiffs brought other suit No.6 of 2000, in the Court of the learned Senior Assistant Judge, Hatibanda within the District of Lalmonirhat for passing a decree for recovery of khas possession by demolishing the unauthorized structures in respect of the schedule land stated in the plaint. 

 3. The case of the plaintiffs in brief is that the schedule land measuring .21 acres of land belonged to the respondent petitioners who sought for a decree for recovery of khas possessions by demolishing structure.
